title: Parse an integer input
summary: Fiber: Parse an integer input. Try /double/cat.
introduction: ParamsInt parses a route value as an integer. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Parse an integer input with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Parse an integer input
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/double/:n", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { n, err := c.ParamsInt("n"); if err != nil { return c.Status(400).SendString("Use a whole number") }; return c.JSON(fiber.Map{"answer": n * 2}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: ParamsInt parses 4 successfully. The handler doubles the integer and returns JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check the error before using the parsed number.
